test: Single synthetic paced file replay; external native timer calls same-source core stop
model_integrity_admission: admitted: successful same-source replay follows the required model verification path; internal verification time not separately measured
limitations: Single synthetic file replay; no physical microphone, UI stop, GPU or installer acceptance.
Captured PCM is an exact prefix; data still buffered in FFmpeg at stop is not measured.
First capture is first polling observation, not exact production time.
The call return time includes several operations; no instrumentation separates model hashing, process launch and worker startup, so cause of delay is not established.
Cold/warm caches and OS load were uncontrolled; this run cannot be interpreted as a controlled performance comparison with prior runs.
The original Q10 4480ms failure remains unchanged; this additional 2176ms failure is not a rewrite of it.
